exposure: major diameters of the female bony pelvic ring
conjugate diameters of the female bony pelvic ring
cohort: 54 female subjects of various ages who had been referred for computed tomography of the pelvis
finding: Gynecoid pelvic type was present in more than half of the subjects, and although this type is considered ideal for labor, the study did not establish that it has a great influence on whether the labor will be performed naturally or by cesarean section, neither that it significantly affects the length of birth.
